notes: Evanston Fair Workweek Ordinance 24-O-23 covers employers with 100+ employees globally (incl. franchises) in retail and other listed industries; effective date moved to Jan. 1, 2024 (city page).

Predictability pay rate equals the employee's regular hourly rate for changes with <14 days' notice; the number of hours per change is not stated on the city page, so change_premium_hours=1 is a placeholder and the rule is confidence=low (excluded by default) until the ordinance text is read.
No right-to-rest rule stated on the city page; not encoded.

rules.summary: Employers with 100+ employees globally must post schedules 14 days before the first shift and pay predictability pay for later changes.

citation.title: City of Evanston — Fair Workweek
citation.excerpt: Employers have to post schedules 14 days before the first scheduled shift.
